facts.name: Ligularia 'The Rocket'
facts.light: Part shade to shade; sheltered from wind
facts.notes: Bold leaves and tall yellow spires for a damp, shady back row. Wilts in afternoon sun or dry soil, so keep it moist.
facts.toxSrc: Contains pyrrolizidine alkaloids (general references; not on the ASPCA list)

sources.title: Bordine's (Michigan garden center): perennials by bloom time, 2026
sources.note: Current perennial list from a Michigan garden center.

companions.why: Combine with astilbe, ligularia and ferns in shade; fine foliage contrasts with hostas.
